system.description:
Kindred speed does not obey ordinary physics, so an object hurled with your full swiftness strikes with force far beyond what its flight should allow.

Spend a Blood Trait and decide how many of your Celerity levels to lend to a thrown or fired object, temporarily losing access to that many of your lowest Celerity levels for the turn. The attack gains one bonus Trait per level granted, and bashing attacks become lethal (an already-lethal attack instead gains one extra health level of damage). Projectile must always be declared and taken as your first action of the turn.
